scenarios.prompt: Device A and B start from cloud revision 41. Only A advances to 42 and uploads. Define how B reconnects and fast-forwards safely.

criteria.revision: Uses slot identity plus revision/generation and base/ancestor semantics, not timestamps alone.
criteria.conflict: Divergence becomes explicit conflict unless fields have declared deterministic merge rules.
criteria.failure: Interrupted sync never overwrites the last valid local generation.
